author: Mark Atwood
text: Marking human-needed. This bead is a strategic design decision about whether JMAP Chat formally engages with W3C DIDs as a principal type. The choice is non-equivalent across the three answers (yes / no / yes-but-companion-draft) and propagates broadly across the spec (ChatContact identity, mention syntax, federation auth binding, push payloads). No technical analysis the agent can do changes which answer is correct — this is a scope/strategy call about the spec's relationship to the decentralized-identity ecosystem. Mark to decide; the bead can sit at P4 until then.
